ambient_events: Down the sealed lane, someone works through a slow, deliberate magazine.
A sign over the register reads: YOU BREAK THE GLASS, YOU MEET THE OWNER.
description: A tight, orderly shop that smells of oil and cold metal. Long guns stand racked behind a scarred counter, ammunition boxed in neat ziggurats, a firing lane sealed off behind scratched glass at the back.
name: Ironside Arms
